name: Cloudreve
description: Cloudreve 4.19.1 is a self-hosted file manager with multi-cloud storage, backed by Postgres and Redis.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  cloudreve:
    image: cloudreve/cloudreve:4.19.1@sha256:5c6c5baf7fa5bc6e1bb9a7509c09dde00e80b618d180244eb1d5f7e36b358ea2
    container_name: cloudreve
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5212"
    environment:
      CR_CONF_Database.Type: postgres
      CR_CONF_Database.Host: postgresql
      CR_CONF_Database.User: cloudreve
      CR_CONF_Database.Name: cloudreve
      CR_CONF_Database.Port: "5432"
      CR_CONF_Redis.Server: redis:6379
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/cloudreve/data
  postgresql:
    image: postgres:17@sha256:d74eeac9a635390a49bc21bd49fccd973de707e2a53a76ac49b552b8712ec46f
    container_name: cloudreve-postgresql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: cloudreve
      POSTGRES_DB: cloudreve
      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  redis:
    image: redis:8.10.2@sha256:6f81e8915c60b065a524e6967e0ad1c639ba6efa84d669f823683ea04d9150ee
    container_name: cloudreve-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis:/data
notes: Open http://localhost:5212 and register an account. The first account becomes the administrator. Postgres uses trust authentication on the internal network, matching the official Compose file.
